title: GenAI Incidents: ID deprecation records (data/id_deprecations.json)
description: Append-only history of every retired incident ID. File order is decision order: for a given `from`, the LAST record without `valid_for_releases` is authoritative. Records carrying `valid_for_releases` are release-scoped and answer only for those releases. Cross-record rules (targets resolve to live entries, scoped sets disjoint, last record per `from` unscoped) are enforced by scripts/validate.py. Policy: docs/ID_POLICY.md. Field reference: docs/DATA_DICTIONARY.md.

into.description: Successor. null = terminal (no successor); a string = one successor (possibly itself retired: follow the chain); an array = every successor of a split.

date.description: Date the record was decided (appended), not the incident date.

valid_for_releases.description: Release-scoped record (v2.13.0, D49): `into` is this ID's successor only for a citation taken from one of these releases. Only ever on appended records.
